Definition: from G700; agreeable; by implication, fit:--(things that) please(-ing), reason.
BiblicalUsage: The word means pleasing, agreeable, fit. Jesus says He always does the things that please the Father, the apostles say it is not fitting to leave the word of God and serve tables, Herod sees that killing James pleases the Jews, and John says we receive from God because we do the things that are pleasing in His sight.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe pleasing God is the only measure that matters, because men are pleased by the wrong things as often as the right ones. Jesus pleased the Father, and that is the pattern.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; John the Apostle; Simon Peter
